events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored his second goal of the game with 1:26 left in overtime to give the Los Angeles Kings a 5-4 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kempe scores in overtime to lift the Kings to a 5-4 win over the Blue Jackets

events.name: New York Rangers at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Mika Zibanejad had two goals and an assist, and the New York Rangers scored on three power plays in a 6-2 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zibanejad's 3-point game helps Rangers rout Flyers 6-2

headlines.description: — Connor McMichael scored twice and the Washington Capitals beat the Calgary Flames 7-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Capitals snap 3-game skid with a 7-3 win over the Flames

headlines.description: — Frank Nazar scored a power-play goal with 2:24 left in overtime to give the Chicago Blackhawks a 3-2 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Frank Nazar scores OT power-play goal as Blackhawks beat Utah Mammoth 3-2

headlines.description: — James Reimer stopped 16 shots for his first shutout of the season and 32nd of his career, and the Ottawa Senators beat the Vancouver Canucks 2-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Reimer makes 16 saves as Senators blank Canucks 2-0
